Riley (PM): two quick asks after today's all-hands: which one thing should teams prioritize next quarter — mission framing, roadmap pacing, or competitor rebuttals?
Ava (CEO): mission-first. but be ruthless with metrics. anything that increases trial-to-paid or reduces per-token cost wins.
Sam (VP Product): concretely: aim work at unlocking Dedicated/Private conversions. those moves shift ARR faster than isolated features.
Jordan (Sales): from the field: customers keep circling back to SLA language, predictable cost, and easier VPC setup. a simple TCO calc would help AEs.
Priya (Head of Research): competitor note: we're seeing loud claims about "faster kernels" and "single-tenant speed." we should collect reproducible signal instead of chasing every paper.
Marta (Eng): could you define "reproducible signal"? is it p99 under a defined load, or peak throughput?
Ava (CEO): reproducible = outcome that changes buying decisions. prioritize stable p99 at scale and consistent tail behavior over microbenchmarks.
Sam (VP Product): action: product will draft an internal acceptance checklist for "production perf" (p50/p95/p99, burst resilience, integration checklist) by next Tuesday.
Jordan (Sales): once that's ready, can we turn key points into 1-slide AE rebuttals? charts + 2-line responses.
Priya (Head of Research): i'll supply benchmark artifacts and a short competitor matrix (claims vs signal) for those rebuttals.
Marta (Eng): eng will produce canonical p99 plots and a small repro script. pairing with research on configs.
deploy-bot: (system) Rollout scheduled: strategy-onepager v2 -> prod at 2023-11-20T02:00:00Z
Riley (PM): thanks all — i'll capture owners and dates and post a follow-up. :memo:
